findings.summary: Graded Low: the refused-ingest log event alert.refused is not in the contract's event table, which says a name is added to the contract first in its own pull request.
Graded Low: the middleware also propagates the caller's tracestate, which the SDK keeps on the exported span, so an unauthenticated request can store caller-chosen text in Tempo.
Graded Low: the real-app tests cannot show the span name comes from the matched route, because the fallback name is the same; only a unit test with a made-up route covers it.
Graded Low: the exemplar on the refused count is not asserted, and duplicate traceparent headers and a deployment with a root path are untested.
Graded Low: the middleware's docstring says it reads no other header, but it also reads tracestate.
